name: mkv
onCreateCommand: git config user.name $(git --no-pager log --pretty="%an" | head -n 1) && git config user.email $(git --no-pager log --pretty="%ce" | head -n 1) && (test -e src-tauri/binaries || ( if [ "$(arch)" = "aarch64" ] ; then export F="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu"; else export F="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"; fi && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp /usr/bin/ffmpeg src-tauri/binaries/ffm-$F && cp /usr/bin/ffprobe src-tauri/binaries/ffp-$F ) )
